verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a first-party Computers feature: a persistent Linux desktop (XFCE, Chromium, LibreOffice) per end user. The changelog says agents can drive it via screenshot, mouse, keyboard and a takeover live view, and dedicated Computers-scoped API keys exist. This directly delivers the full-desktop half of the story. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed docs on running a headless browser programmatically, and clarity on maturity (the changelog phrasing "are getting" suggests an early rollout).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a headless browser or full desktop environment inside the sandbox

citations.quote: A persistent Linux desktop (XFCE, Chromium, LibreOffice) for each of _your_ end users, driven by _your_ model.
Agents are getting a real Linux desktop they can drive: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, and a live view you can take over.
To hand out a key that reaches computers and nothing else, create a **Computers key** in the Computers section of Settings, API keys
